brief:
Bank of Palestine is strengthening its development presence by sponsoring the Fifth Economic Empowerment Conference, the Ma'an news agency reported. The sponsorship reflects the bank's commitment to supporting economic initiatives aimed at advancing Palestinian communities.

The conference focuses on economic empowerment as a central pillar of development strategy in Palestinian territories. Bank of Palestine joined as a sponsor of the program designed to build economic capacity and opportunity.
title: Bank of Palestine sponsors fifth economic empowerment conference
